requirements.statement: Team leads can view the members of their team.
requirements.source_quote: Team leads can view the members of their team.
ambiguity_notes: Which member details are visible is not stated.
Whether a user can belong to or lead more than one team is not stated.
How a user becomes a team lead is not stated.

requirements.statement: Team leads can reset a team member's password.
requirements.source_quote: Team leads can reset a team member's password.
ambiguity_notes: Not stated whether the lead sets a new password or triggers a reset link or email.
Not stated whether the member is notified or sessions are ended.
Not stated whether the action is logged or limited (for example leads resetting other leads).

requirements.statement: Users can change their own display name.
requirements.source_quote: Users can change their own display name.
ambiguity_notes: Rules for display names (length, characters, uniqueness) are not stated.
Not stated whether changes are visible to team leads immediately or are audited.

clarifying_questions.question: Which details of a team member should a team lead see (for example name, email, role, status)?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Determines the data exposed and any privacy implications.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The member view cannot be specified and may expose too much or too little data.

clarifying_questions.question: Can a user belong to more than one team, or lead more than one team, and how is someone made a team lead?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines what 'their team' means and the scope of a lead's permissions.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Permission scope for leads cannot be defined.

clarifying_questions.question: How should the password reset work: does the lead set a new password, or does the member receive a reset link or email?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Security-sensitive; a lead choosing a password for someone else differs greatly from triggering a reset.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The reset behaviour and its security design cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: Should the member be notified, and should the reset be logged, and can a lead reset another lead's password?
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Permission limits and audit behaviour remain undefined.

clarifying_questions.question: Are there rules for display names (length, allowed characters, uniqueness)?

proposed_status_changes.reason: Reset mechanism, notification and limits are not stated.
Visible member details and team membership model are not stated.
